registration.deadline: 60 calendar days after installation for eligible homes, or closing date for new construction; California, Florida, Georgia installations on/after 2026-01-01, Quebec, and other jurisdictions may be exempt or have different choices.
registration.who_may_register: Homeowner; the official portal also has a dealer path that requires the dealer customer number. The exact scope of dealer authority for each registration is product-specific.
registration.portal_accepts_dealer: dealer path is present; the official page says dealers need their customer number.
registration.terms_allow_third_party_preparation: uncertain - please check; dealer portal access is documented, but the reviewed terms do not expressly authorize an unrelated third party to prepare registrations.

date_code.status: published for specific model series; verify by unit
date_code.format: Lennox's 2023 ML17XC1 service guide gives typical serial `58 21 C 05716`: location code (e.g. 58=Marshalltown, IA), 2-digit year code, month letter (A=Jan, B=Feb, C=Mar in the cited guide), then a 5- or 6-digit unique number. The guide is model-series-specific; do not apply this layout to every Lennox generation.

sources.title: Lennox ML17XC1 service guide, typical serial format
